{{Quote|My father used to say, 'You can't think deeper than your pockets,' and there's a lot of truth to that|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Ambush at Corellia" />}}
The '''father''' of [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was one of the [[Parent/Legends|parents]] of [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. One piece of advice that he gave his son was, "You can't think deeper than your pockets."<ref name="Ambush at Corellia" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:LindoCalrissian.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Lindo Calrissian in ''LEGO Star Wars'']]
A fake fact in the segment "[[Mon Mothma's 5 Facts]]" in [[Star Wars Insider 131|''Star Wars Insider'' 131]] claimed that, before being signed on as [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] for {{Film|I}}, [[Samuel L. Jackson]] was slated to appear in a cameo role as '''Grando Calrissian''', Lando's father.<ref name="Star Wars Insider 131">{{InsiderCite|131|Mon Mothma's 5 Facts}}</ref>

[[Raan Calrissian]], who appears in the young-reader's book ''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]'' and is an adult in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], visits [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] and has a contact on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]],<ref name="The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]''</ref> but no source mentions if he and Lando are related.

"[[The Phantom Clone]]," an episode of the non-canon animated series ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles]]'', introduces '''Lindo Calrissian''' as Lando's father. Lindo owns the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and is voiced by Lando's actor, [[Billy Dee Williams]].<ref name="The Phantom Clone">{{YodaChronicles|The Phantom Clone}}</ref>
